text:
maya: noticing that quota metrics are missing for SA-delegated calls — console shows org-level usage but project buckets are zero. Anyone else?

ben: yup saw spike in \"unknown_project\" in ingestion. Looks like routing fallback to org when project lookup fails.

sophie: Do we log auth lookup result? I thought exchange logs have project_id set as `auth.project_id` for token-exchange path.

maya: left a snippet from prod logs — matcher returns null for some tokens:

```
auth_lookup result={\"principal\":\"sa:billing-ingest\",\"project_id\":null,\"org_id\":\"org-72\"}
```

kai: Those are pre-rotation tokens from partner integration that don't have project annotation. Routing policy fallback writes to org-level billing which triggers org quota; but console UI groups by project so shows zeros.

lisa: Oof. So telemetry is correct but console grouping misleading. Could we map org-level entries into \"unattributed\" project tab?

ben: We should: dashboard query currently assumes project_id != NULL. Need to change to:

```
GROUP BY COALESCE(auth.project_id, 'UNATTRIBUTED')
```

sophie: Also, quota engine denies when quota rules are project-scoped. We had deny+fallback to org; that path doesn't emit `quota.reason` tags — downstream metrics missing.

ops-bot: alert created: \"sa-delegation: project-attr-missing\" -> #eng-oncall

maya: UX question: when we roll out a fix, do we reattribute historical metrics? That will affect billing graphs and could confuse customers.

kai: I think reattributing is risky for billing. Better to add an \"unattributed\" bucket and backfill telemetry only for internal metrics (not customer-facing billing) for 30d.

lisa: Agree. For console, show \"Unattributed (org-level)\" with hover explaining reason & link to KB.

ben: For the quota engine patch: implement two-phase rollout: first emit a telemetry tag `project_resolution=attempted|used_org|missing` for all requests, then in a canary flip the routing to try `org->project` vs `project->org`?

sophie: We should avoid changing routing order. Instead: enrich logs with resolution detail.

maya: Who owns the change? Sounds like eng-runtime owns token enrichment; eng-platform owns dashboard/quotas.

kai: I'll take runtime enrichment PR (small change at auth lookup). Ben, can you handle dashboard query + UI label?

ben: Yup. I'll add new panel and a chart explaining `project_resolution`. ETA EOW for query change.

lisa: I'll draft KB blurb and update console tooltip.

sophie: For quotas: we need a canary policy to ensure deny semantics unchanged. Proposal: canary on 5% of requests under dedicated cluster, with metrics tracked: auth.lookup.failures, quota.denied_after_fallback.

maya: Add an alert for spike in `quota.denied_after_fallback > 1%` during canary.

ops-bot: Alert rule suggested: firing when ratio > 0.01 over 5m.

ben: PR checklist: migration for historical dashboards? No. We'll add a migration that creates \"Unattributed\" derived view, but not touch billing exports.

kai: Quick note: update the token-introspect logs to include `token_version` so we can identify pre-rotation tokens.

sophie: sounds good. Let's sync in 15 for quick alignment.

dev-bot: meeting scheduled: 1765440100

lisa: thanks all :thumbsup:
